_doc: Condition-2 exemption ratchet baseline (t/3658), PS side. The active count of VALID model-lint exemptions in PRODUCTION PowerShell (scripts/AITriad/), per kind — a valid `# model-lint:allow-<kind> <reason>` marker on an id that is NOT registered in ai-models.json. The gate FAILS if a kind's live count DIFFERS from its baseline (higher OR lower) without this file being updated in the SAME commit — every add AND every removal requires a reviewed baseline diff. Exact-match (not just fail-on-rise) is deliberate (t/3658, TL pre-flip): it keeps the baseline honest so a stale-high value left behind by an unrecorded removal can never mask later silent growth. Removing an exemption is good — just lower this file in the same commit. Test-fixture markers (tests/) are NOT ratcheted: scaffolding is bounded and expected to fluctuate, so ratcheting it creates false noise (TL, t/3658, mirroring SL's TS exclusion). `nonselect` is tracked separately on purpose: a rising nonselect count signals the extraction regex is over-broad and should be narrowed, NOT that more exemptions are warranted (t/3657#5). Mirrors lib/ai-config/modelLiteralLint.exemptions.baseline.json (TS side, t/3657).
